sources.title: Evaluation System | openai/consistency_models_cifar10 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The evaluation system provides comprehensive model assessment capabilities for consistency models trained on CIFAR-10. It supports three main evaluation modes: loss computation on validation datasets, likelihood estimation (bits-per-dimension), and image generation quality metrics including FID, IS, and KID scores.
